lines: Sold eleven piles to the survey last month. Good money. Should have said no.
They are not putting them in a walkway. They are putting them round the Rock.
You do not ring a thing in piles unless you mean to put something on top of it.
Flat bottom, square ends, and every joint pitched twice. Thirty years, that gets you.
The sea people laugh at the shape. The sea people have a sea. We have eleven inches.
Four years before he lets me cut a strake. Four. I can pitch, though.
I am the best pitcher in this yard and I am the only one who will say so.
A pile goes in eighteen feet and stands for sixty years if you tar the head.
If you do not tar the head, twelve. Everything out here is one small job away from ruin.
